content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to appear for the interview on the specified date, which is 11 September 2026. There is no separate application submission deadline before the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur is recruiting for two posts: Project Technical Support-III and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-III, candidates need a three-year graduate degree in science along with three years of post-qualification experience in medical-related research projects, or a PG degree in Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Technical Support-III position is Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are there for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Data Entry Operator post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the AIIMS Jodhpur office, located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan (Pincode: 342005).

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
